post.title: 69 AIs mastered one ball. I added a second and 0 made it
post.caption: 69 AIs learned to keep one ball up by gen 4. Then I added a second ball and 0 made it. 10 generations later: 1. Gen 25: 6. Gen 40: 13. Each AI is a small neural network; the best ones get copied with mutations.
post.pinned: Each AI is a small neural network that decides how to hit the ball. No one tells it how. The best ones get copied with random mutations into the next generation. From gen 5 there are two balls.
post.notes: Extra reel (Ansh asked for more, Nov 25). Seed 5516, two_at 5. surv: 0,1,17,69 then 0 until gen 15 (1), 25: 6, 40: 13. 15 - 5 = 10. Idea test: question/reaction/unrealistic = 3 of 4.
